fact: Liberia's Cybercrime Act, approved by President Boakai on 3 July 2026, is being enforced after the arrest of a man accused of cyberbullying the Vice President with AI-generated images and videos, while the Cybersecurity Council and specialised cybercrime team the Act requires are not yet set up.
title: Senator Dopoh Accuses Executive of Prematurely Enforcing Cybercrime Law, Demands Key Safeguards
